lots.guide_summary: Eight past Gowans Famicom box lots (Jul to Oct 2026) sold, of which seven made A$25 to A$70 hammer and one made A$2 on a single bid (treated as an outlier). PriceCharting guides (asking/guide, not sales) put the named carts at only US$5.50 to US$10.26 each (A$8 to A$15 at 1.4328). Range A$25 to A$70 is all SOLD at Gowans; no unsold evidence.
lots.working: Keep: the lowest credible same-type Gowans SOLD is A$25 hammer (lot 440829, Sep 2026), which cost that buyer A$29.95 all-in (25 x 1.198). A$29.95 / 1.198 = A$25.00, so keep_max_hammer = $25. The A$2 one-bid result is excluded as an outlier (see its note); if it is counted the strict rule gives $0. Flip: likely resale from SOLD evidence is about A$50 (median Gowans hammer of the seven credible results). Less 13% selling fees (A$6.50) and A$12 outbound postage = A$31.50; / 2.396 = A$13.15, rounded down to $10. Gowans premium 19.8%; pickup from 37 Main Road, Moonah, inbound freight $0. Piecing out on eBay could beat this, but PriceCharting is a guide, not SOLD evidence here.
lots.confidence_reason: Labels on about 8 carts read in the photos and 7 credible Gowans SOLD results opened via the API, but each comp is a different mix of carts, and none are tested, so they are close rather than identical.
lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 1: stack of 14 carts end-on, incl orange Konami Road Fighter (c1985 Konami), orange Naito Kudan shogi, black Konami King Kong 2 (c1986), several plain black, white, cream and pale blue shells with labels facing away. Photo 2: F1 Race (HVC-FR, Nintendo 1984), Hello Kitty title, American Dream (CDS-A7), Clu Clu Land (HVC-CL, Nintendo 1984), King Kong 2 front label. No boxes or manuals.
lots.condition: Loose carts only, normal wear and some yellowing on white shells; labels that are visible look intact. Untested.
lots.question_for_gowans: How many cartridges are in the box, and are any labels missing or torn on the carts facing away in photo 1?
